//: One named executable witness per Definition-of-Done row of the agent edit ledger's phases 2 and 3,
read by scripts/al-witness.mjs through al_witnesses in scripts/lib/al-witness.sh.
Each row: the test (file + exact title; a Rust test's title is its fn name), the work item its header
must cite, the runner that executes it alone, and the regexes the code that ONE case reaches must
match (JavaScript syntax, case-sensitive; comments never count). A witness file that does not exist
yet fails its row by name. Changing a row changes the contract: review it like a gate edit.
